criterion_2_logprobs.consequence_if_failed: the judge returns a label only; narrow the calibration claim in 3.2 to the components and record the deviation in 3.3

criterion_1_parseable.criterion: 1 - output restricted to the label set

criterion_3_limits.note: sequential burst, not a saturation test; the per-day quota is taken from headers or service documentation, not probed

decision_note:
GO (Simon, 2026-09-02), with mistral-medium-3.5-128b as the judge backend. G1.5's second half asks whether a judge call returns parseable, calibratable output; all three D6a criteria pass on this model -- 3/3 outputs inside the label set, token log-probabilities available with 5 top alternatives on the first token (so confidences are real, which D6 requires), and 12/12 calls at 367.5 req/min with no throttling. gemma-4-31b-it also passes all three and is the fallback, but at 14.5 req/min under burst it is ~25x slower. openai-gpt-oss-120b is NOT selected: it fails criterion 1 (harmony channels return empty content). That is a property of one model, not of the judge mechanism, which is why it does not touch this verdict.

Recorded 2026-09-02 because the decision field had said TODO since 2026-08-11 while THESIS_LOG recorded D6a as 'DONE, all three criteria met (#43)'. The log claimed a judgement that was never written down -- the #63/#64/#71 drift pattern. Per-day quota is still taken from the service documentation rather than probed.
note: Credentials are read from .env and are neither printed nor stored here. Per-day quota is not probed by exhaustion; take it from the service documentation. Three candidates were tested (D6 requires a different model family than the LLM component, so the Qwen ids are excluded); the per-model records are kept beside this file as gwdg_smoke_<model>.json. openai-gpt-oss-120b FAILED criterion 1: it emits the harmony channel format (first token <|channel|>) and spent the whole 8-token budget on its reasoning channel, returning empty content, so a reasoning model does not fit a constrained single-label call. gemma-4-31b-it passed all three but is queue-bound under sustained load (14.5 req/min in the burst against 367.5 for mistral, despite comparable single-call latency).

candidates_tested.mistral-medium-3.5-128b: PASS all three; 367.5 req/min; 3/3 labels correct
candidates_tested.gemma-4-31b-it: PASS all three; 14.5 req/min under burst; 3/3 labels correct
